questions.q: Who is the guest of the program?
questions.e: In the video: "Slavimir Stojanović je sa nama, grafički dizajner pre svega" — Slavimir Stojanović is with us, a graphic designer above all.

questions.q: How many years has he worked in the profession?
questions.e: In the video: "Kada proslavljate 30 godina rada" — when you celebrate 30 years of work.

questions.q: What did he buy the sneakers with?
o: His first fee for winning a poster competition
questions.e: In the video: "dobio sam čak i prvi honorar tada. Za te pare... kupio sam starke" — I even got my first fee then. With that money... I bought Starkes.

questions.q: Why did he move from drawing comics to design?
o: Drawing through the nights was hard — his neck hurt, while design with a computer gave more free time
questions.e: In the video: "Boleo me vrat, imao sam spondilozu... kroz dizajn stekao daleko više vremena." — my neck hurt, I had spondylosis... through design I gained far more time.

questions.q: Where do his best ideas come to him?
o: While doing other things — on a walk, with his daughter
At the computer in the studio
questions.e: In the video: "sve smišljam u glavi dok radim bilo šta drugo. Da li se šetam po prirodi, igram sa ćerkom" — I think everything up in my head while doing anything else. Whether I'm walking in nature or playing with my daughter.

questions.q: Why did he leave advertising?
o: For moral reasons: advertising in Serbia comes down to selling
questions.e: In the video: "iz prosto tih nekih moralnih razloga i zbog toga što se naš advertajzing u Srbiji svodi na puku prodaju" — simply for some moral reasons and because our advertising in Serbia comes down to mere selling.

questions.q: What is his exhibition called?
questions.e: In the video: "Izložba se zove „Komplikovana jednostavnost“" — the exhibition is called "Complicated Simplicity".

questions.q: What will be shown at the exhibition?
o: More than 500 works at the Museum of Applied Art
questions.e: In the video: "videće preko 500 radova" — you will see over 500 works.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Dobio sam čak i prvi *honorar*.
questions.e: Honorar — a fee.

questions.q: Deca *tumaraju* sa fakulteta na fakultet.
questions.e: Tumarati — to wander, to roam.

questions.q: *Lenjost* me navela. Lenjost je nekada i dobra.
questions.e: Lenjost — laziness.

questions.q: Živimo u društvu *pokvarenih* ogledala.
questions.e: Pokvaren — spoiled, broken.

questions.q: Ja sam gledao te *uzore*.
questions.e: Uzor — a model to emulate.

questions.q: *Omoti* za CD-ove, od Rambo Amadeusa do EKV-a.
questions.e: Omot — a cover, a wrapper.

questions.q: Ceo taj *dijapazon* bavljenja.
questions.e: Dijapazon — a range.

questions.q: Beograd ima značajne umetnike kojima može da se *ponosi*.
questions.e: Ponositi se — to be proud; ponos — pride.

questions.q: Kada proslavljate 30 ___ rada.
questions.e: After numbers from 5 the genitive plural is used: godina.

questions.q: kako da ___ u Srbiji?
questions.e: After "kako da" a possible outcome takes the perfective: zarade ("to earn"). Zarađuju is imperfective (ongoing).

questions.q: Da, bilo je važno, i onda sam ___ da tu može neki nivo komunikacije,
questions.e: A moment of realisation is perfective: shvatio. Shvatao is imperfective (ongoing). A man is speaking.

questions.q: koji su ___ baš zbog toga što nisu krenuli pravim putem,
questions.e: The adjective agrees with the subject: koji (ljudi) is masculine plural, so nezadovoljni.

questions.q: Nisam hteo da celu noć crtam ___.
questions.e: Crtati what — accusative plural: stripove.

questions.q: Igram sa ___.
questions.e: Sa ("with") requires the instrumental case: sa ćerkom.

questions.q: Izložba je u ___ primenjene umetnosti.
questions.e: U in answer to "where?" — locative case: u Muzeju.

questions.q: Videće preko 500 ___.
questions.e: After numbers from 5 the genitive plural is used: radova.
